about.title: About me
paragraphs: I'm Shivam Sharma, a data analyst based in India. I work with Excel, SQL and Power BI to organize data, investigate questions and communicate results.
I'm studying BSc Life Sciences at Indira Gandhi National Open University (IGNOU). I'm interested in practical analytical work and clear, useful reporting.

contact.note: Please include a short description of the role or project in your message.

privacy.title: Who runs this website
privacy.text: This is the personal portfolio of Shivam Sharma, based in India. For privacy questions, please contact me using the email address on the Contact page.

privacy.title: Information you share
privacy.text: This website has no visitor accounts or contact form. If you email me, I receive the name, email address and any information you choose to include. I use that information to respond to your message.

privacy.title: Hosting and technical data
privacy.text: This website is hosted using GitHub Pages. The hosting provider may process technical request data, including IP addresses and server logs, to deliver the website and keep it secure. Please read GitHub's Privacy Statement for details.

privacy.title: Cookies and analytics
privacy.text: I have not added advertising trackers, marketing cookies or a visitor analytics service to this portfolio. External sites may have their own cookies and policies.

privacy.title: Links and documents
privacy.text: External links, including GitHub and LinkedIn, have their own privacy practices. A resume PDF or project screenshots may be available for download when I publish them.

privacy.title: Your choices
privacy.text: I do not sell personal information from emails sent to me. You can email me to ask about the information you shared, request a correction or request deletion, subject to applicable requirements.

privacy.title: Updates
privacy.text: I may update this policy when the website changes. The latest wording will appear on this page.

terms.title: About this site
terms.text: This personal portfolio describes my education, skills and project work for general information and professional enquiries.

terms.title: Accuracy
terms.text: I aim to keep information accurate, but I may revise or remove content. The website may occasionally be unavailable.

terms.title: Content and copyright
terms.text: Original text, photographs and project materials belong to their respective owners. Please ask before reusing my original work. Linked repositories may contain separate license terms.

terms.title: External services
terms.text: External websites are provided for convenience. I do not control their content or availability.

terms.title: Project findings
terms.text: Project findings and examples are for demonstration and discussion. They do not guarantee a business outcome.

terms.title: Changes and contact
terms.text: I may update these terms. Questions can be sent to the email address on the Contact page. The portfolio is operated from India.
